#HYDTPinfo
🚧 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚧
In view of the RCC Box Drain construction work from SBI Bank, Darussalam to Chaknawadi Culvert (H. No. 14-2-416/2 & 14-2-421), traffic diversions will be in effect from 13-05-2026 for a period of 45 days.
🔀 Traffic Diversions:
1️⃣ Traffic coming from Mallepally, Bhoiguda Kaman & Aghapura towards Alaska T Junction will be diverted at Darussalam towards Ek-Minar.
2️⃣ Traffic coming from Alaska Junction towards Darussalam will be diverted at Calcutta Sweet House towards Chaknawadi by-lanes.
⚠️ Commuters are advised to plan their journey in advance, take alternate routes and cooperate with Hyderabad Traffic Police.
📞 Traffic Helpline: 9010203626
#HyderabadTraffic  #TrafficDiversion #RoadWork
